node.title: Re: hex numbers
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I am simply trying to get the hex value into a variable.

If by that you mean converting something like the string "FE" into the number 254, then what you are looking for is [doc://hex].

Update: And if that's not what you're looking for, please show an [id://1177642|SSCCE], in particular please show the contents of the variable you're trying to convert using [mod://Data::Dump] or [doc://Data::Dumper] with $Data::Dumper::Useqq=1;.
